text:
maria: heads-up: after the 11:00 deploy I'm seeing embedding vector length drift only from Node SDK when KV cache is enabled. Python + curl report 512, node shows 1536. repro below. :confused:

dev-bot: deploy-bot finished canary -> prod (deploy-1123) :rocket:

ben: ugh. sounds like an SDK merge/retry bug. can you paste a minimal repro?

maria: steps:
1) enable KV prefix caching in sampleapp
2) send a batched embeddings request of 3 short docs
3) node sdk prints embedding length 1536 but upstream REST returns 512

maria: node snippet:
```js
const r = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: "open-vect-512",
  input: ["a", "b", "c"],
  batch_size: 3
});
console.log(r.data[0].embedding.length); // -> 1536
```

maria: curl (expected):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"open-vect-512","input":["a","b","c"]}' https://api.redwood.ai/embeddings | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
# => 512
```

sunil: do you see any 401s / auth refreshes in the logs around the request?

maria: yes. first attempt gets 401, SDK refreshes token and retries. server returned three 512 vectors on retry but SDK returned a single 1536-length vector. log below.

maria: logs:
[11:02:05] Request batch id=abc123 size=3
[11:02:05] Response 401
[11:02:06] Refresh token -> success
[11:02:06] Retrying batch id=abc123
[11:02:06] Response 200 payload=[vec0, vec1, vec2]
[11:02:06] SDK returned embedding concatenated-length=1536

alex: sounds like the SDK's batch accumulator is appending the retried response instead of clearing previous partial results when a cached prefix was present. @sdk-team any ideas?

sdk-team: can you include the raw wire trace (request ids, response bodies) and sdk version? which runtime (node v16/18)?

maria: node SDK 1.4.2, node v18.12.0. gist with minimal repro + traces: https://gist.github.com/fake-repro-embed (attached). The trace shows cached prefix bytes being stitched with retried body.

ben: i reproduced locally in sampleapp. deterministic if KV cache returns a prefix and initial auth fails -> retry path hits. quick assert added to catch incorrect lengths.

ben: short workaround: set disable_auto_retry=true or set batch_size=1 for now. both stop the concatenation.

maria: confirmed disable_auto_retry fixes staging. leaving it on until sdk patch lands. :thumbsup:

sdk-team: filed INF-6732, labeled P0. root cause: retry handler merged response buffers into batch accumulator instead of replacing when response code changed. patch underway; planning hotfix tomorrow morning.

dev-bot: incident-bot created INF-6732 and linked to deploy-1123.

alex: could also add a small unit test in batcher to simulate partial cached payload + retry to prevent regressions.

sdk-team: yes will add tests for node + python parity and add e2e with KV cache toggled.

maria: thanks all. leaving staging flag on. will follow up when patch is released.

ben: follow-up note: qa should run the sampleapp embedding e2e with both SDKs and with/without KV cache after the fix.

maria: noted, assigning QA to run smoke matrix.
